subject: Scaling runway snapshot — Elara dedicated sizing alignment
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Oct 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scaling runway snapshot — Elara dedicated sizing alignment

Team —

Elara's deal is moving fast (see HubSpot: ELARA-07). They verbally committed to a Nov 15ish start for a dedicated environment, with a steady-state load profile we received on 2029-10-10 (attached). High-level ask: can we confirm internal capacity for a dedicated pool sized for their expected mix and put a soft allocation lane in place for the next 6 months?

Key numbers from Elara: steady generation ~120 tokens/sec sustained across mixed LLM workloads, peak sustained QPS ~220 for 3–4 hour daily windows. They want 99th percentile latencies in the 150–300ms range and prefer a single-tenant pool for data isolation. Attached csv contains per-hour load sample.

What I need by EOD Wed (Oct 16):
- Inventory feasibility: node / GPU equivalence and earliest start date we can guarantee for a soft hold.
- Suggested footprint: conservative and optimized (e.g., baseline vs quantized).
- Any constraints on model variant mix that would change capacity (e.g., 70B float vs 30B int8).

If we can, please create an internal allocation tag (suggest: allocation:dedicated-elara-2029) so Sales Ops can reference it in the quote. I will follow up with Elara once we have a recommended runway.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Sr. Product Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0214

Attachments: elara-load-profile-20291010.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Oct 2029 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling runway snapshot — Elara dedicated sizing alignment

Soojin —

Quick inventory snapshot for the proposed Nov 15 target:
- Raw fleet available (region us-west): 42x A100-80GB nodes, 18x H100-eq nodes in reserved pools.
- Currently uncommitted capacity that can be carved into a dedicated pool: roughly 12 A100-eq nodes (sustained) without breaking existing reserved SLAs.

Sizing thoughts based on the provided load:
- Baseline (float-heavy, conservative): 12 A100-eq nodes -> approx 720GB aggregate GPU memory, meets target latency at predicted concurrency but minimal headroom.
- Optimized (quantized + mixed smaller variants): we can drop to ~9 A100-eq equivalent by moving some traffic to a 30B int8 variant and enabling KV prefix caching for prompt-heavy requests. That would introduce a small quality delta for a subset of prompts — need product/AE signoff.
- Burst plan: allow access to shared burst pool (additional 6 nodes) for peak daily windows; will need autopolicy to avoid noisy neighbors.

Operational asks:
- If Sales wants a soft hold, we recommend a 14-day soft allocation window tied to an internal allocation tag (no capacity preemption) while procurement runs. For a hard reserve we need signed commitment (PO or contract) to move capacity out of the pool.

I'll draft node-to-GPU mapping and a quick runbook (how we switch model variants and enable quantization) and upload it to the Confluence link you referenced.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Capacity Planning Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Scaling runway snapshot — Elara dedicated sizing alignment

Looping in Sales Ops context:

Elara has indicated they will sign for a 6-month committed period with monthly billing. Procurement asked for a 2–3 week soft hold window during legal/PO review. From a commercial perspective we should flag this as high-priority for runway gating — if we can't provide a reasonable soft hold, they may push start to H1 2030.

Links: HubSpot deal (ELARA-07), and I'm attaching the latest PO draft they sent. I'd like the allocation tag created today so I can include it in the quote and the MSP sheet.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Date: Tue, 15 Oct 2029 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling runway snapshot — Elara dedicated sizing alignment

Emma —

Thanks again for the load sample. Internally, we are provisionally holding an allocation lane for Elara while we finalize sizing details. Summary attached: Dedicated sizing summary (baseline and optimized footprints) and recommended runbook for variant mixing and burst handling.

What we need from you to finalize the hard reserve timeline:
- Confirmation of committed start date (you mentioned Nov 15).
- Any hard constraints on model quality vs token cost (are you willing to accept an int8 variant for lower cost; if so, what percentage of traffic?).
- Procurement timeline for a signed PO.

If you prefer, Marissa can take procurement offline and coordinate PO/Docusign directly (cc'd). We will keep the soft allocation for 14 days starting today (Tue Oct 15) — if we receive a signed PO before Oct 29 we can convert the soft allocation to a hard reservation without further risk to your start date.

Best,
Soojin

Attachments: dedicated-sizing-summary-ELARA.pdf, Elara_MATP_Sizing.xlsx
From: Emma Park <emma.park@elara-sys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@elara-sys.com
Date: Thu, 17 Oct 2029 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling runway snapshot — Elara dedicated sizing alignment

Hi Soojin —

Thanks — the summary is helpful. Procurement confirms the internal PO cycle should finish by Oct 25 and we can sign by Oct 28 at the latest. We prefer the optimized footprint (lower cost) and are comfortable with up to 30% of traffic on the int8 30B variant as a tradeoff — our internal QA will validate any edge-case regressions.

Please proceed with the soft allocation lane and let Marissa know if you need any additional docs from procurement.

—Emma
Emma Park
Head of Platform, Elara Systems
emma.park@elara-sys.com
